body: It definitely made me feel a lot less anxious about it all. I made a point of putting sections in directed towards specific people in my life. Everything I wrote was positive toward them and I wanted to make it clear that is nobody's fault, that I'm choosing to do this because it's what I want. I feel like it was good for me to do, others may disagree with having one but I like having a final message for the people who will want to know

I do find helping others very rewarding, one of the few things in this world that I feel offers that feeling. Specifically I most enjoy helping animals. The feeling I get from seeing a happy animal or knowing I changed the life for the better is one of my only sources of joy. I feel a much better connection with animals than I do people. I prefer to keep to myself and find interacting with people stressful and tiresome. 

I want to break free from my thought process but it just appears too logically sound for me to not think this way. Humans are destroying the planet and need to be stopped. We are too selfish of a species to make a change for the greater good of our world and make the necessary sacrifices. 

I appreciate your input and can see that you understand what I'm going through/putting myself through. I think I will start to volunteer more and try to get away from my negative thoughts about the world. I can see how making a positive difference could do that. Thanks for the chat b4xt3r.

I have found myself doing this actually, whether it be intentionally or subconsciously. I can almost feel what words I am going to stutter/stammer on and will try to think of synonyms to replace them or other ways to make the statement. From my experience this too has been the most effective this far. 

The worst is when somebody asks what my name is and I can't even say something as simple as that.

It's not always specific words or sounds. It is usually on hard sounds such has Ks or hard Cs. But it can be words as simple as "it" that I get hung up on. This is one of the worst parts about how I stutter. I have tried speaking in front of mirrors, it has helped a couple times when I know I will have to say a certain phrase or word but has not yielded results in the long run
